column5: What this is. A product-agnostic standard for how data flows into, through and out of AI systems: which data may reach which model, how it is minimized and redacted, how long every AI artifact lives, how data-subject rights reach prompts, traces, caches, embeddings, memory and training sets, and how training, synthetic and eval data are governed. It expands guardrails G9, G15 and G20 and the PII-sanitization rules of the generic eval strategy (§7.11) into an operating standard.
